config.name: supplemental-resnet50-v3
config.rationale: Preregistered before reading any v3 scores to meet ITRI626_Project_New.md sections 6 and 7: three distinct model families evaluated on the same split. Historical ResNet results are not split-matched. This supplemental baseline is not eligible for the frozen primary selector; choices are assessment-driven, not based on observed scores.
config.split: learning.grouped_folds with protocol seed and identical sorted manifest rows; optional primary fold_assignments.csv must match exactly
config.weights_integrity: Verify published filename SHA256 prefix for cached/downloaded weights and record complete downloaded-file SHA256 before training.
config.batch_norm: all running statistics frozen; layer4 affine parameters trainable after epoch 2
config.schedule: single 10-epoch cosine, eta_min=0, step after each epoch; no reset at unfreeze
config.batch_override: Explicit CLI choice only, recorded in effective config and hash before training; batch 8 accumulates 4; no OOM retry or score-based change.
config.partial_batch: Accumulate summed losses; divide gradients by actual images in each update, including the final partial update; drop_last=False
config.amp: CUDA float16 autocast with GradScaler; CPU float32
config.epoch_seed: seed + outer_fold*1000 + zero_based_epoch; final uses seed+100000+epoch; initialize model at first epoch seed
config.determinism: Python/NumPy/torch epoch seeds, seeded loader generator, deterministic algorithms, no TF32 or cudnn benchmark
config.selection: none: fixed 10 epochs, no early stopping, no outer validation during training; final epoch outer evaluation exactly once
config.final: Independent 10-epoch fit on all development images; fresh holdout is inference-only with source-group and image-content overlap refusal
config.artifacts: Float32 CPU state_dict .pt plus JSON class/preprocessing/config/input/implementation/weight/checkpoint hashes; no optimizer or resumable checkpoints
